item.tib: gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod gzhung nges pa'i thig le
item.coloph: gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba bsgrubs ((sgrub) pa'i 'phrin las/ mchod gzhung dang bcas pa 'di ni/ rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo 'bum rgyud rnams dang / kong tse 'phrul rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i phyag len chog khrigs rnams kyi nang nas/ 'phrin las nyung la 'dus pa rgya nag legs tang rmang pos/ bdud 'dul ru tra'i gling du khrigs su bsgrigs pa'o// rag phrom gyi brag nas go lde 'phags pas gter zhal phyes/ rke phu na ro'i gong sangs su/ shog ser la phabs nas kun la spel ba'o/ dri ma med pa'i dge rtsa rgya che 'di/ dri bcas sems can byang chub thob par bsngo/ dri bral mthar thugs bon gyi sku thob nas/ dri med snying po'i gnas lugs don mthong shog 'dis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs du kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
